description: A named augmented-reality AI navigation and feedback system for self-directed flexible-bronchoscopy training, developed for critical-care physicians and pulmonary bronchoscopists.
title: Ambu Broncho Simulator

description: A teacher-certification pathway, including the Passport to Teaching credential, developed and administered by the American Board for Certification of Teacher Excellence for alternative-route teacher candidates.
title: American Board for Certification of Teacher Excellence (ABCTE) alternative teacher certification

description: A national student-club programme organized by the American Industrial Arts Association to familiarize students with industrial and technical fields through tours, club activities, and leadership conferences.
title: American Industrial Arts Student Association (AIASA) student industrial arts clubs

description: The ASLAI is a computerized battery of video-presented multiple-choice receptive ASL language tasks developed by the research team for assessing deaf students' ASL abilities and informing IEP planning.
title: American Sign Language Assessment Instrument (ASLAI)

description: A proposed federal programme to recognize highly effective K–12 public school teachers and provide eligible teachers, especially those in high-poverty Title I schools, with recognition, salary supplements, and a portable credential.
title: America's Teacher Corps (ATC)

description: A forced-choice questionnaire developed to measure education students' beliefs across five philosophical dimensions: Realism, Idealism, Pragmatism, Existentialism, and Phenomenology.
title: Ames Philosophical Belief Inventory

description: A Benedetti-developed AI-mediated educational interaction device, deployable as a digital agent or social robot, that provides either procedural task guidance or reflective dialogue under age-sensitive configuration and governance constraints.
title: Amico dual-mode prototype (AmicoMio and AmicoTuo)

description: Amira Learning's Amira is an AI-powered personal reading tutor that assesses oral reading fluency, provides individualized reading practice and intervention, and reports diagnostic information to educators and families.
title: Amira

description: Amplify Science is a phenomena-based K–8 science curriculum developed and provided by Amplify Education, integrating hands-on investigation, literacy practices, modeling, and explanation to support three-dimensional science learning.
title: Amplify Science

description: AMSTAR-2 is a structured critical-appraisal instrument developed by Shea and colleagues for assessing the methodological quality and overall confidence of systematic reviews of healthcare and educational evidence.
title: AMSTAR-2

description: The Alabama Math, Science, and Technology Initiative is a state-run programme that combines summer teacher training, school-year coaching, and rotating instructional materials kits to support hands-on, inquiry-based mathematics and science instruction.
title: AMSTI
